shortDescription: Shares of PC Jeweller NSE:PCJEWELLER rose as much as 8.6% to their highest since May 2018 on Thursday, after the company posted a more than 50% jump in quarterly profit and said it had fully repaid debt owed to a 14-bank consortium.Shares were trading 4.1% higher at 19.2 rupees as of 9:20 a.m. IST.
